subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued donor, We are excited to invite you to our Annual Charity Gala on Saturday, November 20th at the Grand Ballroom. Join us for an elegant evening of dinner, entertainment, and fundraising for a great cause. Your support has made a significant impact, and we would be honored to have you with us. Please RSVP by October 30th to secure your spot. We look forward to seeing you there!
